blocks.text: With love and devotion, the student turned to the teacher and asked:

"Show me the one service that holds all others within it. Tell me how to walk this path without losing my way. How can I avoid getting lost among so many spiritual, philosophical, and social teachings? How can I stay a student of truth forever, without falling into pride?"
"Just wanting to ask such questions is already a great blessing. It comes from above — from teachers and good deeds from past lives.

Only one thing makes a heart truly sincere: wanting nothing in return except knowledge that gives birth to love; except service that leads to even deeper service; except respect that grows naturally in the heart.
Because a tree bends low when its fruit grows ripe.
A sincere and loving heart shows respect to everyone, because it sees God's presence in each person. Pride can never touch a heart like this.
Such a person's mind wants to speak only of the Divine — to learn from those who are wiser, and to share what they learn with those who suffer.
Their mind stays in meditation, and their lips keep singing the Holy Names.
Their body bows before the great souls, and their spirit surrenders completely to God.
Only a person like this truly deserves to walk the Path — and becomes a living example of it.

Remember: meeting someone like this is very rare in this world. If you're lucky enough to meet them, become their friend, their helper, their servant. Listen to every word they say. Give them your time, your strength, your heart.
And they will show you the endless Path that already lives inside you.
Everything already lives within us — but someone has to light the candle. Fire cannot start on its own. It needs a spark.
And once lit, a candle brings light not just to itself, but to others too."
With these humble words, the teacher finished the story, rose, and disappeared into his own endless Path...
The students kept his words in their hearts. With tears of joy and deep respect, they continued on their own paths, knowing the teacher would live forever in every heart.
